asOf: Assumed after M79 Mexico 2-0 Ecuador, with Julián Quiñones and Raúl Jiménez as Mexico scorers (2026-06-30; game not final at request time)
source: Manual assumed update requested by user: treat Mexico-Ecuador as final 2-0 and add goals for Julián Quiñones and Raúl Jiménez. Penalty shootout goals excluded.

sourceNotes.name: SB Nation Golden Boot table
sourceNotes.note: Used as the complete scorer table including all one-goal scorers, goals, assists, and minutes; table says it was updated Jun 28, 2026 at 13:50 UTC and following Group J matches.

sourceNotes.name: FOX Sports Golden Boot tracker
sourceNotes.note: Cross-check for all players on 2+ goals; confirms Messi 6 and Wissa 3.

sourceNotes.name: Sporting News Golden Boot rankings
sourceNotes.note: Cross-check for top table; confirms Messi 6 and Wissa 3.

sourceNotes.name: FIFA match report, Portugal 1-1 Congo DR
FIFA match report, Jordan 1-3 Argentina
sourceNotes.note: Confirms Lo Celso, Lautaro Martínez and Messi scored for Argentina; Messi moved to 6 tournament goals.

sourceNotes.name: Guardian/ESPN match report, DR Congo 3-1 Uzbekistan
sourceNotes.note: Confirms Wissa scored twice against Uzbekistan, giving him three tournament goals when combined with the Portugal goal.

sourceNotes.name: Qatar 1-1 Switzerland reports
sourceNotes.note: Boualem Khoukhi restored as Qatar scorer after cross-checking match reports.

sourceNotes.name: Croatia 2-1 Ghana reports
sourceNotes.note: Derrick Luckassen restored as Ghana scorer after cross-checking AP/Sky/Guardian/FOX/ESPN match reports.

sourceNotes.name: 2026-06-29 Round of 32 scorer updates
sourceNotes.note: Added regulation-time scorers from Brazil 2-1 Japan, Germany 1-1 Paraguay, and Netherlands 1-1 Morocco. Penalty shootout kicks are excluded from Pichichi totals.

methodNote: Proxy model: final player goals = current goals + number of remaining matches played by that player's team in each Monte Carlo simulation. Assists/minutes are included for audit/tie-break context and are ignored by the current simulation code.
